projetos.titulo: Project on Controlled Natural Language for Portuguese
projetos.descricao: Researches controlled natural language techniques to support clearer, more formal communication in Portuguese and improve language-processing workflows.

projetos.titulo: Evaluation of local LLM performance for translation
projetos.descricao: Measures how well local language models perform in translation tasks and compares quality, latency, and practical deployment trade-offs.

projetos.titulo: Evaluation of tools for Defeasible Deontic Logic support
projetos.descricao: Explores existing tooling and frameworks for defeasible deontic logic, assessing their usability and support for formal reasoning tasks.

projetos.titulo: Survey of tools for natural language requirements formalization
projetos.descricao: Reviews tools and methods that transform natural-language requirements into formal specifications, with a focus on reliability and practical adoption.

projetos.titulo: Development of an open-source educational translation tool
projetos.descricao: Creates a student-oriented translation support tool to teach practical translation workflows while promoting open-source and educational use cases.
